Product Description

The CubeMars AK80-9 V3.0 KV100 robotic actuator integrates a brushless DC motor, 9:1 planetary gearbox, and driver board into a compact, easy-to-install unit. This module delivers enhanced torque output and control stability while maintaining high responsiveness. It supports multi-loop control (position, speed, torque, and MIT hybrid mode), features plug-in connectors and automatic PID parameter identification, and includes built-in protection against overcurrent, overvoltage/undervoltage, and overheating, ensuring reliability and safety in complex environments.


The upper computer supports one-click intelligent parameter identification and seamless switching between servo and MIT modes, significantly simplifying the commissioning process. Combined with real-time status monitoring, it ensures precise control and stable communication in complex applications. Ideal for collaborative robotic arms(cobot) and robot limb joints, this actuator also supports customization, providing an efficient and reliable power solution for portable intelligent automation and research fields.

Product Highlights

Fully Integrated Design BLDC motor, gearbox, driver, and encoder are integrated into a single unit, greatly simplifying system architecture
High Stability Rated torque of 9 Nm, peak torque up to 22 Nm, suitable for various medium-load applications
Flexible Control Supports both servo control and MIT hybrid control modes, adaptable to multiple control strategies
Auto Tuning / PID Identification Eliminates complex manual tuning, streamlining the development process
Comprehensive Protection Integrated overcurrent, overvoltage/undervoltage, and overtemperature protection enhances system safety
Plug-in Connection Design Reduces complexity and failure risks associated with traditional wiring
Wide Range of Applications Especially suitable for exoskeletons, legged robots, joint drives, and robot limb joints

CubeMars is a brand under Sanrui Intelligent (IPO in 2026), focused on robotic power systems. With 17 years of R&D experience, it fully designs and manufactures its product line in-house. The company specializes in compact high-torque planetary module and frameless motors, with an annual output of 6 million units and international certifications, widely used in humanoid robots and exoskeleton applications.
